name: Radioactive
source: Tesseract Modular Radioactive 1.2 user manual.pdf p.7 (manual p.4, Default controls panel diagram)
notes: Jacks 5-8 are CV inputs whose function is mode dependent (PITCH is 1V/oct; jack 6 is ATTACK in mode A, GLIDE in modes B/C); with nothing patched the matching pots act as manual controls. WAVE (jack 9) is a trigger input advancing the waveform. TRIG/GATE (jack 15) behaviour set by G-T-P setup.
